lore.text: John Constantine was born in Liverpool, England. His mother died in childbirth, for which his father blamed John, resulting in a strained relationship between them. John learned that he came from a line of occult practitioners known as the Laughing Magicians, and he began to explore mysticism and magic. John left home as a teenager, moving to London and forming a punk band whose roadie, Chas Chandler, became a lifelong friend. Young and defiant, he felt ready to conquer the world, but had no idea of the horrors that awaited him.

While on tour in Newcastle, Constantine discovered a scene where an abused child had inadvertently conjured a monster that took revenge on her abusers, but then would not leave or let her go. John summoned a demon to destroy the monster, but being inexperienced at magic, he didn't use the demon's true name and thus did not have full control over it. The demon, Nergal, destroyed the monster but took the little girl back with it to hell. Following this horrific incident, Constantine had a nervous breakdown and was committed to Ravenscar Psychiatric Hospital for an extended period. After learning more about magic, Constantine felt ready to confront Nergal again. Through magic and trickery, he freed the souls of the little girl Nergal had taken, along with other children trapped in Hell.

While studying magic, Constantine met and began a romance with fellow student Zatanna Zatara. But Constantine was a restless and roguish type and could never stay in one place for long. He also had begun to feel that being around him was dangerous, so he moved on. Years later, when a supernatural threat called the Great Darkness loomed, Constantine assembled mystics including Zatanna and her father Zatara to probe it. The Darkness detected them and attacked Zatanna, but Zatara magically redirected the attack onto himself and was killed. While she knew it wasn't Constantine's fault, Zatanna couldn't help but hold him partially responsible, and while they have remained friends and occasionally shared a romantic moment or two, they haven't managed to rekindle their relationship.

Constantine has lost many friends and romantic partners over the years. Some have been killed, often as a result of being associated with John. Others have left after seeing the horrors of the life he leads. A rare exception is his old friend Chas Chandler, now a married taxi driver and one of the few normal people who has survived being a friend of Constantine's, although even Chas often gets frustrated with John and stops speaking to him for periods of time. John's older sister Cheryl and her daughter Gemma still live in Liverpool, but Constantine tries to stay out of their lives as much as possible, knowing that the likelihood is he will only bring the darkness of his world into theirs.

Constantine, a lifelong smoker, learned he had terminal lung cancer. The First of the Fallen, a Lord of Hell, was eager for revenge due to Constantine having prevented him from collecting the soul of a friend some time earlier. Due to the right of insult, the First had a claim on Constantine's soul when he died. Constantine outsmarted him by selling his soul to two other Lords of Hell, equal in power to each other. To prevent a war over Constantine's soul between the three of them that would destroy them all, and avoid the humiliation of one of them losing the soul to the others, they had no choice but to save John's life by curing his cancer. Now, he just has to find a way to get out of forfeiting his soul to them before he actually dies.

Despite being a loner who moves in the shadows, Constantine has helped other beings and heroes on occasion. He has allied with the Swamp Thing on numerous occasions and even been a member of the Justice League Dark, an offshoot of the Justice League in which Zatanna is a leader. It deals with supernatural threats the regular League is not equipped to confront. John enjoys making fun of costumed heroes when he crosses their path, but when real disaster threatens, he is always ready to lend a hand.

guide.overview: Constantine is a **scaling** Spiritual DMG dealer whose Ultimate **grows stronger with each cast**, up to 2 times.

legacyPieces.name: Sigil Magic
legacyPieces.reason: Constantine's signature gear. Its universal skill increases Spiritual Penetration and Attack, enhancing his spiritual damage. Its exclusive skill boosts his active skills with additional AoE damage. With the scaling damage mechanics, Constantine deals devastating AoE damage after his second Ultimate.

legacyPieces.name: Imp Doll
legacyPieces.reason: Grants Energy Gain Bonus, allowing Constantine to reach his power spike earlier, while also increasing Spiritual AMP and granting a chance to apply healing reduction. With his Ultimate's scaling damage, Constantine deals devastating AoE damage as the battle progresses.

legacyPieces.name: Plastic Explosive
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Attack and Spiritual Amplification. Constantine's Ultimate damage scales with each cast, so a higher base Attack makes each subsequent cast hit even harder.

legacyPieces.name: Replica Time Commander
legacyPieces.reason: Provides a pure Attack bonus. With the Attack bonus from [Justice League Dark] allies present, Constantine deals even more damage as the battle progresses.
